name: Black Bag Limit Exemption
description: Application for exemption to place out additional black bags if recycling all accepted materials.
decision_tree_md:
START
- If recycling all accepted kerbside materials:
  - If producing more than three black bags of non-recyclable waste:
    - If no recyclable material in black or exemption bags:
      - APPROVE
    - Else:
      - REFUSE
  - Else:
    - REFUSE
- Else:
  - REFUSE
state_transitions_md:
| Current State | Trigger | Next State | Action |
|---------------|---------|------------|--------|
| Submitted     | Review  | In Review  | Assess application |
| In Review     | Approve | Approved   | Notify applicant of approval |
| In Review     | Refuse  | Refused    | Notify applicant of refusal |
evidence_requirements_md:
| Evidence                   | Required? | Source    | Verification Method |
|----------------------------|-----------|-----------|---------------------|
| Proof of recycling compliance | Yes       | Applicant | Review submitted documents for compliance with recycling requirements |
correspondence_templates_md:
### Application Submission Confirmation

Dear {{ applicant_name }},

Thank you for submitting your application for a Black Bag Limit Exemption. We have received your application and it is currently under review.

Best regards,
Swansea Council Waste Management Team

### Decision Notification

Dear {{ applicant_name }},

We have completed the review of your Black Bag Limit Exemption application. Your application has been {{ decision }}.

{{#if decision == 'Approved'}}
You are now exempt from the black bag limit and may place out additional bags as specified.
{{/if}}

{{#if decision == 'Refused'}}
Unfortunately, your application did not meet the necessary criteria for exemption.
{{/if}}

Best regards,
Swansea Council Waste Management Team
risk_scoring_md:
- If recycling compliance evidence is not provided, increase risk score by 50%.
- If application history shows previous non-compliance, increase risk score by 30%.
- If all criteria are met, decrease risk score by 20%.
